coverage.description: Count words in prose sentences in live JSON records and repository Markdown. Schemas and fictional JSON examples are outside this check.
Detect a fixed list of filler phrases. This check cannot detect all poor writing.
Detect common English contractions in prose.
Detect exact avoid forms from the technical glossary. Unknown terms and meanings need manual review.
Check evidence, repetition, relevance, and the meaning of progress claims before approval.
Review new domain terms and their sources. Do not add ordinary English words to bypass a finding.
Check approved words, their word classes, and meanings against Issue 9. A complete STE dictionary check is not implemented.
Review the applicable Issue 9 writing rules. The project checks do not establish compliance with those rules.
